candidates.title: A Positive Judgment Is Not Yet an Effective Approval
candidates.title_zh: 判断通过，不等于批准生效
candidates.researchQuestion: 在人工智能生成的批准判断成为组织内有效签署之前，必须具备哪些证据；哪些变化应当使这份权限失效或收窄？
candidates.coreProposition: An AI approval judgment becomes an effective sign-off only when separately authorized for a named gate, scope, and freshness identity; changes to the reviewed object, governing evidence, or authority-sensitive context must invalidate or re-evaluate that authority.

sections.heading: One Word Hides Five Governance Questions
sections.heading_zh: 一个词藏着五个不同问题

sections.heading: The Organizational Sample Separates Assessment, Submission, and Gate Effect
sections.heading_zh: 组织审查样本：评价、提交与门禁效力分开

sections.heading: The Agent-Runtime Sample Makes Context an Authority Boundary
sections.heading_zh: 智能体运行样本：上下文连续不等于权限连续

sections.heading: Invalidation Should Follow Enumerated Change, Not Intuition
sections.heading_zh: 失效规则要绑定变化，而不是绑定感觉

sections.heading: Simple Interfaces Need Not Erase Durable Facts
sections.heading_zh: 简化界面可以，简化控制事实不可以

evidenceClaims.claim: GitHub documents that a Copilot approval assessment is distinct from administrator-enabled permission to submit approving reviews and from whether that approval can satisfy merge requirements.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: GitHub 文档把 Copilot 的批准评价、由管理员启用的批准提交能力，以及批准能否满足合并要求区分为不同事实。

evidenceClaims.claim: GitHub documents policy hierarchy, optional changed-file path qualification, and dismissal of earlier Copilot approval after new commits.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: GitHub 文档记录了策略层级、可选的变更文件路径资格，以及新提交后旧 Copilot 批准被撤销的规则。

evidenceClaims.claim: OpenAI Codex maintainer commit 87628df versions Guardian root-authorization evidence, cancels stale Allow results, treats missing required evidence as incomplete, restores bounded evidence across compaction, and strips parent-only approvals on worker fork in covered paths.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者提交 87628df 在覆盖路径中版本化 Guardian 根授权证据、取消过期允许结果、把缺失必要证据视为不完整、在上下文压缩后恢复有界证据，并在派生工作智能体时移除父级专属批准。

evidenceClaims.claim: The two samples place authority-freshness boundaries at different layers while preserving a shared distinction between positive judgment and operational authority.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本次比较观察到，两个样本在不同层设置权限新鲜度边界，同时都区分正面判断与可产生效力的权限。

evidenceClaims.claim: Governed approval should be represented by separate judgment, capability, effective-gate, scope, and freshness facts whose protected identities have explicit invalidation rules.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，受治理的批准应分别记录判断、能力、门禁效力、范围与新鲜度，并为受保护身份定义显式失效规则。

projectRelevance.rationale: The argument compares external organizational-review policy and open-source agent-runtime mechanisms.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already provides the transferable governance model and action checklist without a distinct community angle.

candidates.title: Passing Tests Is Not Operational Capability
candidates.title_zh: 测试通过，不等于具备运行能力
candidates.researchQuestion: 在什么证据充分具备之后，才能把智能体生成并迭代的软件称为具有运行能力，而不只是通过了生成期间可用的功能测试？
candidates.coreProposition: Functional success and a rich agent development trace are necessary but insufficient evidence of operational capability; stronger completion claims require a separate, risk-proportionate qualification gate over the relevant workload, concurrency, resource, topology, and reproducibility dimensions.

sections.heading: An Iterative Trace Matters, but It Describes What Was Exercised
sections.heading_zh: 迭代过程很重要，但它只说明练过什么

sections.heading: Scale Introduces New Failure Propositions
sections.heading_zh: 规模扩大后，新的故障命题才出现

sections.heading: Five Evidence Layers Should Not Collapse into One Green State
sections.heading_zh: 五层证据，不要压成一个绿色状态

sections.heading: Ordinary Engineering Should Translate the Dimensions, Not Copy HPC Metrics
sections.heading_zh: 普通工程不需要照搬超级计算机指标

sections.heading: Reproducible Does Not Mean Generally Reliable
sections.heading_zh: 可复现不等于普遍可靠

evidenceClaims.claim: The independent Agentic Julia study uses iterative planning, code and test generation, execution, repair, and performance experimentation, and publishes prompts, artifacts, logs, tests, and runtime data.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 独立的 Agentic Julia 研究采用迭代规划、代码与测试生成、执行、修复和性能实验，并公开提示词、工件、日志、测试与运行数据。

evidenceClaims.claim: In the reported supercomputing experiments, some generated implementations that passed small functional checks later deadlocked, oversubscribed resources, exhausted memory, crashed, or timed out at larger workloads or parallelism.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 据该超级计算实验报告，部分通过小规模功能检查的生成实现，在更大负载或并行度下随后出现死锁、资源过度订阅、内存耗尽、崩溃或超时。

evidenceClaims.claim: The study reports material differences between the generation environment and the target supercomputer's distributed-memory topology, process placement, resource constraints, and core counts.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 该研究报告称，生成环境与目标超级计算机的分布式内存拓扑、进程放置、资源限制和核心数量存在实质差异。

evidenceClaims.claim: Functional, development-process, operational-failure-envelope, scaling, and transfer/reproducibility evidence answer distinct completion propositions.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本次分析观察到，功能、开发过程、运行故障边界、伸缩与迁移/可复现证据回答不同的完成命题。

evidenceClaims.claim: Agent-generated software should advance through qualified completion gates matched to the operational consequence being claimed, rather than inheriting production readiness from local test success.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，智能体生成的软件应按所声明的运行后果通过分层完成门禁，而不能从本地测试成功直接继承生产就绪结论。

projectRelevance.rationale: The argument derives from independent public research and remains useful without any first-party project.

communityEdition.rationale: The Research Center edition already supplies the practical evidence model and risk-proportionate checklist; no distinct professional-community angle would add enough value.
